sender: Dr. Priya Patel, The Riverside Surgery
transcript:
Dear Mr. Whitfield,

Following your Ramipril dose increase in May, I can confirm we have reviewed your blood pressure today and it is much improved. Please continue on Ramipril 5mg and Furosemide 40mg as prescribed by the renal team.

We will await the results of your nephrology follow-up appointment in August.

Dr. Priya Patel

open_loops.description: GP to review blood pressure after Ramipril dose increase
